introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your arms stretched forward. 

Then lift your upper body off the floor. Hold for a few seconds and slowly return. 

It primarily works the rectus abdominis muscle and the obliques.
name: ABDOMINAL CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Use your abdominal strength.
You will get better results if you do it slowly.
Relax your neck.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
It's not right to use your arms to propel your body upwards.
To fully engage your abs, please don't use explosive strength.
Exhale when raising, and inhale when lowering.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
You should feel your abdominal muscles burning.
You shouldn't feel your neck is sore.
It's a good workout for your abs.

introduce:
Start with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. 

Inhale and let your belly relax. Then, on the exhale, engage your core to extend one arm and the opposite leg. 

Hold for five seconds, then go back and repeat with the other side, coordinating with your breaths.
name: BIRD DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your stretched arm and leg parallel to the floor.
Your toes should point toward the floor.
Tighten your abs.
Don't lift your arm or leg up too high.
This is a good exercise for your core.
This targets your abdominals and lower back.
This helps you build your endurance and get good balance.
Exhale when lifting your arm and opposite leg, and inhale when lowering them.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under butt and your hands under shoulders. \n\nThen lift your right leg and squeeze your butt as much as you can. Go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.
name: DONKEY KICKS RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
To get better results, keep your core tight.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your gluteus, and can also work on your hamstrings.

Always keep your core tight.

Lift your leg as you exhale and lower it as you inhale.

This exercise tones and firms up your butt and thighs.

tips.text: You should do it on a mat.
Exhale on the way up, and inhale on the way down.
If you feel it's too easy, raise both your legs and arms at the same time.
This exercise will engage your abs.
This exercise will strengthen your butt and lower back.

introduce: Lie on the floor with your toes and forearms on the ground. Keep your body straight. \n\nBend your left knee and bring it to the outside of your left arm. Return to the starting position and repeat with the other leg.
name: SPIDERMAN PLANK

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.

Try to bring your lifted knee to the outside of your arm as close as you can.

introduce:
Sit on the floor with legs extended. Put your hands directly under your shoulders with your fingers pointing toward your hips. 

Lift your hips off the floor. Keep your body straight. Hold this position.

Don't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.
name: REVERSE PLANK

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.

Don't sink your hips.
Please put your hands directly under your shoulders.
This exercise helps burn your back fat, tighten your core and improve your posture.

introduce:
Start in a side plank position with your right forearm on the floor and your left hand behind your ear. 

Then squeeze your abs, and bend your left knee. Bring your left elbow and left knee close to each other. 

Go back to the start position, and repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE PLANK KNEE CRUNCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.

introduce:

introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.

Inhale, extend your left arm up toward the ceiling, rotating your chest open to the left. Exhale, thread your left arm underneath your body, lowering your left shoulder and the side of your head to the floor. Extend your right arm forward.

Hold for a few seconds. With each inhale, lengthen the spine; with each exhale, deepen the stretch. Return your right arm and repeat the pose.
name: THREAD THE NEEDLE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your hips directly above your knees during the exercise.
Don\'t collapse your right shoulder into your neck.
This exercise stretches your shoulders and upper back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax into the twist.

introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.

Inhale, extend your right arm up toward the ceiling, rotating your chest open to the right. Exhale, thread your right arm underneath your body, lowering your right shoulder and the side of your head to the floor. Extend your left arm forward.

Hold for a few seconds. With each inhale, lengthen the spine; with each exhale, deepen the stretch. Return your left arm and repeat the pose.
name: THREAD THE NEEDLE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.

introduce:
Sit on the floor with your knees bent. Place your hands behind your hips and shift your weight back slightly.

As you exhale, straighten your legs to a 45-degree angle from the floor. Your body should be forming a “V” shape. Inhale to lift your arms up while opening up your shoulder blades wide

Hold this position. Inhale as you lengthen through your spine, and exhale to release tension and engage your core. Avoid holding your breath.
name: BOAT POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
Don\'t arch your back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to engage your core and relax.
This exercise targets the rectus abdominis, obliques, and transversus abdominis.
This exercise enhances your core strength.

introduce:
Lie flat on a mat, extend your legs at an angle from the mat. Engage your core, lift your shoulders off the mat with arms straight by your ears, shoulder-width apart. Inhale to prepare.

Exhale, bend your knees towards your chest as you sweep your arms out to the sides, reaching around to grasp your shins or ankles and squeeze.

Inhale, reach your arms over your head and keep your legs long.

Repeat the exercise.
name: DOUBLE LEG STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your shoulders lifted.
Please keep your core engaged.
This exercise can stabilize your core muscles.
This exercise helps with your abdominal strength.
Exhale as you bend your knees towards your chest.
Inhale as you extend your arms overhead and keep your legs long.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended into the air. Lift your shoulders off the mat with arms extended parallel to the ground.

Inhale through your nose for a count of 5, then exhale through your mouth for a count of 5 while simultaneously pumping your arms up and down.

Repeat the exercise.
name: THE HUNDRED

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.

Please keep your legs straight.
Please do not strain your neck and head.
This exercise can strengthen your core and back.

introduce:
Lie flat on your stomach with your legs extended hip-width apart and your toes pointed. Place your hands under your forehead.

Bend one knee and pull your heel toward your hips. Then pull again with your foot flexed and pull the last time with your toes pointed. Put your foot back to the start position.

Switch your feet and repeat the exercise.
name: SINGLE LEG KICK

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your thigh on the mat.
Please make sure your spine is neutral and stable.
Please keep your shoulder blades down.
Please do not strain your lower back.
This exercise can train your back hamstrings.
Exhale as you kick your heel toward your hip in three small pulses.
Inhale as you extend your leg back.
